info.description: The shipped public developer API. Base URL is the developer-api edge function. Auth is an API key (bmp_live_… / bmp_test_…) in the X-Api-Key header. Keys are created in the app (Business settings or the API page); only the SHA-256 hash is stored and the full key is shown once. TEST KEYS ARE READ-ONLY: this app has no test-mode ledger, so a test key can never move real money. Write attempts with a test key return 403 test_mode_read_only. Not available via the API (dark rails, documented honestly): MoonPay, Stripe, Payoneer partner API, and virtual-card issuing to third parties.
info.title: BMaGlass Pay Developer API

get.description: Scope: bitcoin:read. Returns crypto_wallets rows (balance_sats / available_sats).
Scope: bitcoin:read. Returns the address already issued to the account in the app. The API does not derive addresses: if none exists this returns 404 no_deposit_address.

post.description: Scope: bitcoin:read. Creates a price-locked quote using the same live price sources and 1.5% (150 bps) fee as the app's btc-trade function. Quote only — execution happens in the app, not via the API. Test keys may create quotes (no money moves).

get.description: Lists the key owner's payment links (newest first, max 100). Each link carries its stored fee_payer plus the computed fee_amount, buyer_total and seller_receives for its price at the current platform rate (null on any-amount links).

post.description: Creates a payment link for the key's owner and fires payment_link.created. fee_payer is optional: omit it to inherit the merchant's account default (see GET /settings). The response carries the RESOLVED fee_payer plus the computed fee_amount, buyer_total and seller_receives for the link's price at the current platform rate — seller-pays at K100/2.5%: buyer_total 100.00, seller_receives 97.50; buyer-pays: buyer_total 102.50, seller_receives 100.00. The computed amounts are null on any-amount links (no fixed price).

fee_payer.description: Optional per-link override of who funds the platform fee. When omitted, the link resolves the merchant's account default (GET /settings -> fee_payer_default), which the merchant sets in their BMaGlass Pay dashboard. The resolved value is stored on the link and enforced at settlement; it cannot be changed at pay time.

post.summary: Create a payment link (live keys only)

get.summary: The merchant's account settings that connected clients inherit
get.description: Returns the merchant's payment-link fee-bearer default (fee_payer_default: 'seller' — the platform fee comes out of what the seller receives; 'buyer' — the fee is added on top of the price and the seller receives the full price) and the platform's current payment-link fee rate (platform_fee_percent). The default is set by the merchant in the BMaGlass Pay dashboard (Settings > Payment) — plugins, extensions and SDKs have no fee-bearer setting of their own; they read it here and inherit it. Read-only; available to any valid API key (test keys included).

200.description: The merchant's effective fee-bearer default and the platform fee rate.

post.description: Scope: transfers:write. LIVE KEYS ONLY — test keys get 403 test_mode_read_only. Charges the standard 1.5% transfer fee on top via execute_transfer_with_fee, exactly like the app. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe. Emits transaction.completed to registered webhooks.
post.summary: Send a wallet-to-wallet transfer (live keys only)

get.description: Every delivery attempt: event, URL, status, HTTP response status and error.

get.summary: List webhook endpoints (secrets are never returned)

post.description: HTTPS URLs only. The signing secret (whsec_…) is returned exactly once in this response. Events: transaction.completed, payment_link.created, payment_link.paid, webhook.test. Allowed with test keys (no money moves). The payment_link.paid payload's data carries the link id/code/title, the amount and currency, the fee truth (fee_payer, fee_amount and total_charged — what the buyer actually paid in total, so a shop can reconcile the paid total against its order total plus the fee where it added one), the settlement transaction ids and the link's current payment_count/total_collected.

200.description: Delivery attempt(s) with status; also written to the delivery log
